Kill [[Mungri Magicbox]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Mungri Magicbox in [[Ferndale]].
* *BONUS* Kill Mungri Magicbox in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Kurzick faction|Kurzick Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Mungri is located close to the [[Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)]] entrance to Ferndale. Note that the area is swarming with Dredge [[patrol]]s, so advance carefully and [[pull]] each group to avoid over [[aggro]]ing. He is a powerful [[healer]] and often has a [[Dredge Gardener]] in his [[mob]]. [[Interrupt]]s, skills that [[punish]] [[heal]]ing or [[enchantment]]s are recommended due to the boss's reliance on [[Life Bond]] and other enchantments.
